releaseNotes:
Test build 1.6.4. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched.

LEGEND: the six device-role rows (Trigger, Constraint, Monitor, Action, Exposed, Owns) only showed a coloured LINE. A focused device turns into a coloured DOT, and nothing in the legend looked like a dot, so a purple or green circle on the map had no matching swatch to find. Each row now shows both.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
